notes.title: Steam Deck & Linux Support
notes.notes:
We’re excited to share that thanks to the power of [b]Proton[/b], we’re able to ensure full compatibility and support for both [b]Steam Deck[/b] and [b]Linux[/b]!
Our team has been rigorously testing on personal machines to guarantee a smooth experience, but we know that real-world testing is key. That’s why we’re calling on the Steam Deck community to help us out.

If you own a Steam Deck and are passionate about helping us fine-tune the performance, we’d love to hear from you! Your feedback will be invaluable in making sure everything works seamlessly, from performance to usability. We’re committed to providing the best experience possible for all users, whether you’re playing on Linux or Steam Deck.

If you're interested in contributing, join our [url=https://discord.com/invite/CAhVGsAW7H]Discord Server[/url], and let’s make sure we get this right!

Thank you for your support, and stay tuned for more updates!
